summary.headline: Astrological Progressions
summary.text: Discussion of astrological progressions in almanacs, including the ascendant and Mars at the year’s turning, the luminaries, lunar nodes, lots, lunar mansions, terms, faces, and planetary distances. Progressions are defined as fivefold operations linking indicators to future events, with examples involving Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, houses, pivots, quartile, opposition, trine, and sextile.
